console.award.tierUp: {firstName} just reached {tier}. Time for a congrats!
console.undo.hint: You can undo an entry for up to {minutes} minutes after it's made.

console.device.noStore: This account isn't set up as a till device for a store. Ask HQ to set it up.
console.employee.empty: No staff are set up for this store yet. Your store manager adds them in the back office.
console.employee.locked: The till locked after {minutes} minutes without use. Type your PIN again.
console.scan.noCamera: The camera isn't available. Type the code instead.
console.scan.typeHint: The member code under the QR, or a reward code, with or without spaces.
console.late.hint: Only for today's receipt from this store. Each receipt earns points once.

signIn.body: For HQ and store managers. Enter your email and we'll send you a one-time code.
state.notConfiguredBody: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (see the README).
state.errorBody: We couldn't load the data. Refresh the page in a moment.
office.signedOut.title: Sign in to carry on
office.signedOut.body: The dashboard, members and staff are for HQ and store managers.
office.noAccess.title: You don't have access yet
office.noAccess.body: {email} has no role in the back office. Ask HQ to add you under Staff.
office.device.title: This is a till account
office.device.body: Till devices work from the Till screen.
office.hqOnly: This page is for HQ only.
signIn.codeBody: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it here.
signIn.error.send: We couldn't send a code. Check the email and try again in a moment.
signIn.error.code: That code is wrong or has expired. Try again or ask for a new one.
dashboard.nothingYet: No activity in this period yet.
staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Cashiers with PINs, till devices, store managers and HQ admins.
staff.cashiersHint: At the till, cashiers pick their name and type their PIN. A PIN has {minDigits}–{maxDigits} digits, nothing easy like 1111 or 1234.
staff.noCashiers: No cashiers at this store yet.
staff.cashierAdded: Added: {name}. They use the till with the PIN you set.
staff.pinChanged: New PIN for {name}. If it was locked, it's unlocked now.
staff.cashierOff: Switched off: {name}. They no longer show at the till.
staff.accountsHint: Each till device has its own email and signs in once with a code. A manager sees their store and sets up its cashiers.
staff.noAccounts: No accounts for this store yet.
staff.accountAdded: Added {email}. It signs in with a code sent to that email.
staff.hqHint: They see the whole network and the members, and can correct points. There's always at least one.
members.title: Members
members.intro: Find a member, see their history and correct points when needed.
members.searchHint: Member code, email, mobile or name
members.adjustHint: For a purchase that wasn't scanned, or a mistake. The reason stays in the history. Corrections don't count towards the tier.
stores.introHq: Every store in the network. Change details and opening hours, open a new store or close one.
stores.codeHint: Goes into the counter QR, e.g. glyfada. Latin letters, digits and dashes. It can't change later.
stores.codeFixed: The code {code} is printed on the counter QR and can't change.
stores.coordsHint: Optional, from Google Maps (right-click the store). Without them, directions in the app use the address.
stores.coordsInvalid: Coordinates are numbers, e.g. 37.9838 and 23.7275, and go in both or neither.
stores.hoursHint: Leave a day empty if you don't know it yet. Closing at 00:00 means midnight.
stores.hoursMissing: {day}: fill in both times, or clear both.
stores.hoursOrder: {day}: the closing time must be after the opening time.
stores.created: New store: {name}. Next, add a till and cashiers from Staff.
stores.closeWarning: Close {name}? Members won't see it and its till won't give points. Cashiers and history stay.
stores.closedDone: {name} is closed. Members no longer see it.
rewards.introHq: The reward catalog. The in-store price sets the point cost, using the program's rules.
rewards.priceHint: What a customer pays for it. The points come from this.
rewards.priceInvalid: Enter the price in euros, e.g. 2.50.
rewards.priceChangeNote: A new price means a new point cost. Codes already made don't change.
rewards.orderInvalid: The position is a whole number from 0 to 100000.
rewards.created: New reward: {name}. It's already in the app.
rewards.switchedOff: {name} is out of the app. Codes already made stay valid until they expire.
reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: The rewards handed out at each store per month: which, how many, by which cashier and what they cost the store.
reports.valueHint: Value: the reward's in-store price when it was handed out.
reports.empty: No rewards handed out this month.
